GRUB_DISABLE_MEMTEST.description: If set to true, memtest entries are not added to the GRUB menu.

GRUB_MEMTEST_DISABLE_SERIAL.description: If set to true, serial console entries for memtest are not added.

GRUB_MEMTEST_SERIAL_PARAMS.description: Serial console parameters for memtest (e.g., ttyS0,115200).
